    Contour scalar families and simultaneous rescaling #

    Package the multiplicative coboundary used in the final step of the multiplicative-basis standardness theorem. An exact family of nonzero scalar discrepancies on any collection of parallel path pairs is removed simultaneously by one unit-valued rescaling of all quiver arrows.
